# The Jordan World Circus

> > The Jordan World Circus is a traveling family entertainment show operated by Jody and Melanie Jordan, touring venues across the western United States.

The circus performs at various venues including Livestock Events Centers and Shrine Club locations in cities like Reno, NV and Grants Pass, OR. Tickets are sold through Strawhouse Ticketing with tour dates and show information available on the website.
